name: Notable AI vs Freed
title: Notable AI vs Freed: Healthcare Automation vs AI Scribe Comparison
description: Compare Notable AI and Freed for healthcare documentation. See differences in focus areas, features, and which is right for your practice.

summary.bottom_line: Notable AI and Freed solve different problems. Notable automates administrative workflows (intake, prior auth, billing), while Freed is an AI scribe for clinical documentation. They are complementary rather than direct competitors. Choose Notable for admin workflow automation; choose Freed for clinical note generation.

sections.heading: Notable AI vs Freed: Overview
sections.content: Notable AI and Freed address different healthcare challenges and are not direct competitors. Notable AI is a healthcare automation platform that streamlines administrative workflows: patient intake, scheduling, prior authorizations, insurance verification, and billing processes. Freed is an AI medical scribe that listens to patient visits and generates clinical documentation. They could actually be used together—Notable handling admin tasks while Freed handles clinical notes. The comparison here clarifies their distinct roles.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Freed has transparent public pricing for clinicians: Starter ($39/mo), Core ($79/mo), Premier ($119/mo). Notable AI uses enterprise pricing based on patient volume and modules, typically targeting health systems and large medical groups with implementation fees. The pricing models reflect different buyers: Freed sells to individual clinicians; Notable sells to operations and revenue cycle leadership. Most solo practitioners wouldn't evaluate Notable; most health system administrators wouldn't buy Freed individually.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: The feature sets barely overlap. Notable's strengths: automated patient intake, prior authorization automation, real-time insurance verification, scheduling automation, and billing workflow improvements. Freed's strengths: ambient listening during visits, SOAP note generation, psychiatry/therapy note formats, ICD-10 coding suggestions, and individual clinician accessibility. Notable does NOT generate clinical notes from patient visits. Freed does NOT automate prior authorizations or intake. They are complementary tools for different problems.

recommendations.when: You're a health system seeking to automate administrative workflows—intake, prior auth, billing—and reduce staffing burden on back-office operations
You're a clinician wanting to reduce documentation time by having AI generate clinical notes from patient visits
You're a health system wanting comprehensive automation—Notable for admin workflows and a separate AI scribe (Freed, Dragon Copilot, etc.) for clinical documentation

faqs.q: Is Notable AI an AI scribe like Freed?
faqs.a: No, Notable AI is NOT an AI scribe. It focuses on administrative workflow automation (intake, prior auth, billing). It does not have ambient listening or clinical note generation. Freed is the AI scribe; Notable automates admin tasks.

faqs.q: Can I use Notable AI and Freed together?
faqs.a: Yes, they are complementary. Notable could automate your intake, scheduling, and prior authorizations while Freed generates your clinical documentation. There's no conflict—they solve different problems.

faqs.q: Which is better for reducing clinician burnout?
faqs.a: Freed directly reduces clinician documentation time (the biggest burnout driver for many). Notable reduces administrative staff burden which indirectly helps clinician workflows. For direct clinician impact, Freed is more relevant.

faqs.q: Can solo practitioners use Notable AI?
faqs.a: Notable primarily serves health systems and large medical groups with enterprise pricing. Solo practitioners typically wouldn't qualify for or need Notable's admin automation at that scale. Freed is much more accessible for solo practitioners.
